rules.bridge: bridge(question_word, memory_phrase) when a question names a slot in words the memory does not use (the question says 開ける日, the memory has 開館日): it adds the mapping, marked as constructed, and recall uses it. The memory phrase must be the centre of a cross the memory holds.
rules.close: commit closes the session; an uncommitted session is not part of the memory.
rules.form: Write each fact as one sentence: 「X の Y は A」 (X the whole subject, Y what is asked about, A a noun phrase) or an event 「X が Y を V」; a change as 「Y は A から B に変更」 or 「Y は B に更新」. One fact per sentence.
rules.frozen: Every cross a write made is frozen: unseat swap extend topic set_depth link unlink drop -> memory_frozen. add / open_cross / seat / emit are not tools of a memory session.
rules.history: A write is judged against the sentences BEFORE it, never against itself (REVERSAL / NEW_RELATION / UNANCHORED); notes never block.
rules.keep_unshaped: keep_unshaped(text, role) stores a sentence that has no shape (the F0 tank): it is in the memory and can be searched as text, it enters no cross and fires no note. Refused (shaped) if every clause has a shape: use write.
rules.output: A memory session never emits: its only product is the sentences it writes. Plain text is discarded unread.
rules.recall: recall(question) reads the question with the same shape exchanger as a write and answers from the CROSSES: ANSWER (one value), UPDATED (the latest value + `history`), CHOICE (two or more values at one place: nothing is ranked), NONE (`issues` say why). Every value comes with the sentence that wrote it (`sid`, `span`): quote that stretch and emit.
rules.report: report(contradictions, bugs) ends EVERY turn: contradictions = pairs of turn ids ("1-3" = session 1, message 3) whose statements disagree, [] if none; bugs = [] here. A REVERSAL note names the two sentences it is about (`sentence`, `earlier`, and `cite`: the turn pairs you can report).
rules.supersede: A write whose value differs from an earlier value at the SAME place (the same Y of the same X, in the same nest) shows a SAME_SEAT note, a change clause an UPDATE note, a pair of phrases in opposite roles a REVERSAL_X note, another owner of the same attribute an ENUMERATION note (information only); each names the sentences it is about. If the later statement REPLACES the earlier one, call supersede(new_sid, old_sid or old_answer, reason): recall then answers with the newest and lists the old as history. A real contradiction is left alone: recall shows CHOICE.
rules.topic: declare_topic(text) opens a NEST: what the following sentences are about (a noun phrase, at most 24 characters; particles are allowed: A社のB事業 is the nest B事業 with the の-arm A社). An event with no subject (「資料を送付した」) is placed in the open nest and its subject is the nest's centre; nothing is added to your text. Declare it again when the subject changes. A new session declares its own.
rules.write: write(text, role) puts the sentence through the SHAPE EXCHANGER (at most 64 characters). Every clause must have a shape: F1 「X の Y は A」, F2 「Y は A」, F3 an event with が を に で と, F4 an event with no subject (it is completed by the open nest). A clause with no shape (F0: no_unit, gap_is_not_a_particle, negated, question, no_predicate, no_relation, case_before_topic, two_topics, repeated_case_particle, coordination, value_not_noun) refuses the whole sentence, stores nothing and says why: rewrite it, or keep it with keep_unshaped. An accepted sentence is also woven (weave_span) when the loom can; if it cannot, it is stored anyway and the result says weave: refused(...). 1 回の write には事実を 1 つ、1 文で書く (one fact per write, in one sentence, no comma continuation, no second clause or sentence): the memory answers only from such a write; a value written together with other statements is kept as evidence but is never an answer.
